declarations.name: capability
declarations.notes: The new comment is stylistically clean: imperative verb opening ('Marks'), third-person present tense, no HTML, no self-reference ('This class...'), appropriate altitude for a one-sentence annotation. No @return applies. One nit: the file now contains two Scaladoc comments for the same declaration -- the pre-existing detailed block (lines 6-15, with example and -Ycc note) plus this replacement for the 'TODO FILL IN' placeholder. Scaladoc tools use only the comment immediately adjacent to the declaration, so the richer pre-existing block becomes an orphaned comment that readers may stumble over. Conventionally, each declaration carries exactly one Scaladoc comment; the two blocks should be merged into the position immediately before the class.
